About Us

Thoughtful event design with reliable execution.

Transtenthouse offers world-class decoration, tents and catering management services for weddings, ceremonies, religious functions, private parties, corporate events, live concerts and large celebrations.

Based in Lutyens Delhi, the team creates well-designed customizable packages for institutions, clubs, corporate houses, hotels, lawns and family functions. From tent erection and lighting to floral decoration, DJ, sound systems and dance floors, every layer is planned with comfort, beauty and dependable delivery.
